title: Made a golf course tycoon game, out now on iPhone, iPad and Mac
author: Lwelchyo
selftext:
You start with an empty field and enough money for about three holes. You design each hole yourself: tees, greens, doglegs, bunkers, lakes. Then golfers turn up and play it, and you run the club from there. Hire greenkeepers, set your fees, build out the clubhouse, buy more land.

There is some detailing options and after some progress, you can set custom pin placements, modify terrain and unlock new buildings and upgrades via a research tree.

Eventually you’re hosting tournaments, starting at a club championship, then major and a Ryder cup.

It’s one purchase and you get it on iPhone, iPad and Mac and saves carry across via iCloud.

Built with Unity, Claude Code and Blender for assets.

[https://apps.apple.com/app/id6822689691](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6822689691)
